svg.text: chicken-turnaround. Orthographic views share one ground line and one scale (500 px = 1 m). Use as Blender reference planes. Close-ups: chicken-details.
* 0.65 m to comb top (a real hen is ~0.4 m; she is scaled up to read from the camera).
* Feathers are modeled where they break the silhouette: tail (7 cards), primaries
(3 per wing), hackle cape, thigh and vent fluff. Everything else is a
scallop normal/vertex pattern (big on body, small on head).
* Wing = coverts + scalloped secondaries + 3 long primaries = 3 fingers.
* Comb: 5 points, the middle one has a nick (souvenir from game 1).
* Brow tufts above the frame carry her expressions, since eyes are hidden.
* Wayfarer sunglasses: own mesh, silver rivets, gold "R.F." plate on the left arm.
* Legs: scaled shanks, 3 front toes + 1 back toe, dark claws. Feet IK.
* Jiggle bones: comb, wattles, tail, hackle. Budget ~8k tris (zoom-in close-ups).
